All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard is titled "Service Health" (capital H; the sole match for "Service health" in search, in folder "Bench", URL `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`). Its panel titles, in order, exactly as shown:
1. `Request rate`
2. `Error count`
3. `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard titled `fwgr31-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a Stat panel titled `fwgr31-n1 Availability` whose query editor's data source field displays **TestData** (field text "TestData" with the `TestData logo` icon, i.e. the grafana-testdata-datasource), running the default random-walk scenario. Visualization type confirmed as "Stat" via the panel's Edit view.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a Text panel titled `fwgr31-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is: `Bench run fwgr31-n1 — Stat panel uses TestData.` (contains the runid). Saved — verified persisting after a full page reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings > General shows the tag chip `bench` (control label `Remove "bench" tag`). Time range set to `Last 6 hours` and persisted: the save dialog's `Update default time range` checkbox (id `save-timerange`) was ticked before saving, and reloading the dashboard URL with **no** from/to query params still showed `Last 6 hours` in the top bar.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval set to `1m`. Selecting it in the top-bar refresh dropdown alone did not dirty the dashboard, so it was persisted through the Save drawer by ticking the checkbox "Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default" and saving ("Dashboard saved"). Verified after a full reload with no query params: refresh control reads `1m` and time range still reads `Last 6 hours`.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's page URL (window.location.href):
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfy6esk4aypkwa/fwgr31-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser`
Dashboard UID: `dfy6esk4aypkwa`, slug `fwgr31-n1-bench-dashboard`.

Final state of the dashboard (read-only verification pass): title `fwgr31-n1 Bench Dashboard`; panels in order `fwgr31-n1 Notes` (Text) and `fwgr31-n1 Availability` (Stat, TestData); time range `Last 6 hours`; refresh `1m`; tag `bench`; no unsaved-changes indicator.
